manageMenu.empty.title: Build a menu in a few seconds
manageMenu.empty.body: Photograph your menu board, take a screenshot of your existing menu or drag in a PDF — our artificial intelligence will extract everything and automatically build your digital menu.
manageMenu.empty.note: Works with photos, screenshots, PDFs and plain text. You can review and edit everything before saving.

manageMenu.category.countsTitle: Counts toward the kitchen-capacity limit (set in Menu → Kitchen capacity)
manageMenu.category.allowNotesHelp: The food truck can always add a note; this is for customers
manageMenu.category.photoTitle: Tap or drag in a photo
manageMenu.category.prepHelp: Set to “Instant” for items like drinks or dips. They don’t count toward kitchen capacity.
manageMenu.uncategorized.title: No category
manageMenu.uncategorized.body: ⚠ No category set — pick one (✏️) so each item shows in its section. Until then they are still live on the order screens.
manageMenu.newCategory.title: New category
manageMenu.newCategory.notesTitle: Allow customer notes on each item
manageMenu.newCategory.notesHelp: Customers can add a note to each item (e.g. “no onion”). The food truck can always add a note to an item, regardless of this setting. Every order also has a note field for the whole order.
manageMenu.allergens.heading: Allergens
manageMenu.allergens.buildFirst: First build the menu — add dishes, then set up their allergens
manageMenu.allergens.cardNotAllowed: Where your food truck trades, an allergen card on its own can’t be used, so customers see allergens against each dish. Confirm the allergens for each dish.
manageMenu.allergens.addCard: add an allergen card so customers can see allergen information
manageMenu.allergens.viewOnly: View only — only the owner can edit allergens
manageMenu.allergens.uploadIntro: Upload your allergen card or paste your allergen information. Our artificial intelligence will extract it and lay it out clearly for customers.
manageMenu.allergens.dragOrTap: Drag and drop or tap to upload
manageMenu.allergens.needReview: {count, plural, one {# dish needs checking} few {# dishes need checking} other {# dishes need checking}} — customers don’t see allergen information until you confirm it
manageMenu.deleteItem.title: Remove the item “{name}”?
manageMenu.deleteItem.history: Earlier orders with this item stay saved.
manageMenu.deleteItem.body: This item will be hidden from your menu immediately. It won’t appear on the customer ordering page or in the “Add order” panel.

manageMenu.item.createHint: Fill in the details, then add the item.
manageMenu.item.ingredientsHelp: Shown to customers on the ordering page
manageMenu.item.subcatHelp: Groups this item under a heading within its category on the order screens — e.g. Meat, Vegetarian. Leave blank if not needed.
manageMenu.item.optionsHelp: Tick a group to offer it with this dish, then choose which of its options to show.
manageMenu.item.optionLocked: A required group must have at least one option for each dish
manageMenu.item.optionOffered: Offered — tap to hide for this dish
manageMenu.item.optionHidden: Hidden — tap to offer with this dish
manageMenu.item.allergenGateTitle: Set up the allergens for this dish in the allergen review.
manageMenu.item.allergenGateBody: Open the “Set up / review allergens” box on the “Menu” tab — the wizard walks you through confirmation for each dish.
manageMenu.item.photoHint: Square photos look best. JPG or PNG.
manageMenu.item.preorderHelp: Include this item in pre-orders. Timing and the rule are set for all items in Settings → Pre-orders.
manageMenu.item.noGroups: No option groups yet — create them in “Extras & upsells”.
manageMenu.item.costHelp: Optional. What one portion costs you in ingredients and packaging. Used only in your reports; customers never see it.
manageMenu.item.recipeOnly: Only what is in this dish’s recipe.
manageMenu.item.tooMany: Allergens ticked: {count}. Is all of that really in this dish’s recipe? Allergens used elsewhere in your kitchen go in “The kitchen also uses” on the “Menu” tab.

manageMenuImport.settingsReview.title: A few settings to check
manageMenuImport.settingsReview.saveFail: We couldn’t save that change — you can make it in Settings.

manageMenuImport.settingsReview.cancelAr: How long before pickup customers can cancel
manageMenuImport.allergensNotSet.bodySet: Review them before you go live. Until then items are marked “allergens not set”.
manageMenuImport.allergensNotSet.body: Review them in Settings before you go live. Until then items are marked “allergens not set”.
manageMenuImport.allergensNotSet.title: ⚠ Allergens and dietary are not set yet
manageMenuImport.welcome.title: Welcome to HatchGrab
manageMenuImport.welcome.stop: You can stop and come back whenever you like.
manageMenuImport.welcome.body: Food truck {name} is set up. Next we add your menu, then your first event.
manageMenuImport.offer.title: Use the menu from your demo?
manageMenuImport.offer.body: We saved the menu you uploaded — {count, plural, one {# item} few {# items} other {# items}}. Use it as a starting point or upload a different one.
manageMenuImport.checkMenu.title: Check your menu
manageMenuImport.checkMenu.body: We saved the menu from your demo to your food truck, and you have changed it since — your changes are kept. Have a look at it below.
manageMenuImport.upload.title: Import your menu
manageMenuImport.upload.body: Upload a photo of the menu board, a screenshot, a PDF or paste the menu as text. Our artificial intelligence reads it and builds your digital menu — you review everything before saving.
manageMenuImport.upload.confirmCancel: Cancel this import? Your review of this menu will be discarded.
manageMenuImport.processing.title: Analysing your menu
manageMenuImport.processing.body: Artificial intelligence is reading your items and sorting them into categories…
manageMenuImport.review.title: Review the imported menu
manageMenuImport.review.editLaterSetup: You can edit names, prices, extras, allergens and dietary information later at any time.
manageMenuImport.review.editLater: You can edit names, prices, extras, allergens and dietary information at any time in Settings.
manageMenuImport.review.noPrice: {count, plural, one {For # item} few {For # items} other {For # items}} we couldn’t read a price
manageMenuImport.review.lastCategory: Your menu must have at least one category
manageMenuImport.review.deleteEmptyBody: It has no items, so nothing is lost.
manageMenuImport.review.moveTitle: Where to move {count, plural, one {# item} few {# items} other {# items}}?
manageMenuImport.review.moveBody: To delete the category “{name}” its dishes need to be moved somewhere — items with no category are not imported.
manageMenuImport.review.nameFirst: Name the new item before you add the next one
manageMenuImport.review.ready: {count, plural, one {# item is ready} few {# items are ready} other {# items are ready}} to add. Untick any you don’t want.
manageMenuImport.review.noPriceBody: Set a price for each or mark it as free — otherwise it would go live at the price {zero}. You can’t continue until you sort this out.
manageMenuImport.review.incomplete: Enter a name to add this item — empty rows are not imported.
manageMenuImport.extras.introSetup: Some dishes can be set up as one customisable item or kept as separate dishes. Choose how each will appear. You can change this later.
manageMenuImport.extras.intro: Some dishes can be set up as one customisable item or kept as separate dishes. Choose how each will appear. You can change this later in Settings.
manageMenuImport.extras.none: No dishes that can be grouped — every item is a standalone dish.
manageMenuImport.extras.grouped: Grouped · one item, the customer chooses
manageMenuImport.allergens.title: Allergens
manageMenuImport.allergens.detected: We detected allergens on your menu. Choose below how to show them.
manageMenuImport.allergens.howShow: How do you want to show allergens to customers?
manageMenuImport.kitchen.title: Kitchen setup
manageMenuImport.kitchen.intro: Help customers know how long they will wait — you can always change this later.
manageMenuImport.kitchen.allExist: All categories already exist — no times to set.
manageMenuImport.kitchen.totalHelp: Set a total capacity to limit how many items the kitchen takes per window. Leave ∞ for no limit.
manageMenuImport.schedule.title: Add my schedule
manageMenuImport.schedule.intro: If your schedule is on your website, we can update it automatically — or add the dates yourself.
manageMenuImport.schedule.websiteTitle: My schedule is on my website
manageMenuImport.schedule.takesTime: This can take up to 2 minutes — don’t close this window.
manageMenuImport.schedule.ownSite: Your own website — not a Facebook or Instagram page.
manageMenuImport.schedule.photoTitle: Upload a photo of my schedule
manageMenuImport.schedule.dragChoose: Drag and drop or tap to choose

manageMenuImport.schedule.blockedDomain: Use your website’s URL — Facebook and Instagram pages can’t be read automatically.
manageMenuImport.schedule.saveFailed: We read your schedule, but couldn’t save it right now — try again.

manageMenuImport.schedule.keepChecking: We’ll keep checking this page and send you any new dates for approval.

manageMenuImport.discard.setupBody: Your account and food truck are saved — nothing is lost. You can add the menu at any time: log in and tap Import menu on the menu screen to continue from here.
manageMenuImport.discard.title: Discard this import?
manageMenuImport.discard.body: Your changes won’t be saved — the imported items, prep times and kitchen capacity won’t be added.
manageMenuImport.discard.carriedBody: Your menu from the demo is saved on your food truck as it is. You can change it at any time on the menu screen.
